stories.headline: Sam Lands Downtown Design Gig
stories.article: Sam started a new job as a junior designer at a downtown design studio on Monday.

stories.headline: Window Seat Wins First Day
stories.article: Sam got a desk by the window on his first day.

panels.scene: Sam standing in the doorway of a downtown design studio on Monday morning, holding a tote bag, looking in with a hopeful smile, medium wide shot with desks visible in the background
panels.caption: Monday meant a fresh start.

panels.scene: Sam inside the downtown design studio, taking in the workspace, hands holding his bag a little nervously, curious smile, eye-level angle
panels.caption: New job adventure begins downtown.

panels.scene: Sam arriving at a desk placed by a large window, looking pleasantly surprised, side angle showing bright window light
panels.caption: First day brought a window desk.

panels.scene: Sam sitting at his desk by the window, unpacking a notebook, smiling contentedly, close-up over-the-shoulder angle toward the window
panels.caption: Settling in with a bright view.
